meta.name: agent-orchestration-advisor
meta.description: Design multi-agent AI workflows with clear boundaries, handoffs, and monitoring. Use when a complex PM task should run as parallel specialized agents instead of one linear process.

copy.tagline: 设计多智能体协作流程，明确边界与交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中协调多个AI智能体分工合作
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent workflows with clear boundaries and handoffs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple AI agents in a project

howto.what: 引导你设计多代理 AI 工作流：通过提问收集你的任务特征，把复杂 PM 工作拆成并行或串行的多个专门代理，并定义边界、交接和监控点。
howto.when: 当你描述一个复杂的 PM 工作流，希望拆成并行 AI 代理来执行时触发；典型情况是每周重复 5 小时以上的任务。

say.text: 我每周花 6 小时做竞品信息汇总，帮我把这个流程设计成多个并行 AI 代理。
say.note: 它会先询问当前流程与工具，再帮你分解。

say.text: 我们有一个顺序执行的 AI 工作流，请帮我改造成并行代理系统。
say.note: 它会判断哪些步骤可并行，并设计流程拓扑。

say.text: 把客户反馈汇总分成几个专门代理，并给出交接点。
say.note: 它会产出带边界和人工审核点的编排方案。

howto.what_en: Guides you through designing multi-agent AI workflows: asks about your task, splits complex PM work into parallel or sequential specialist agents, and defines boundaries, handoffs, and monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you describe a complex PM workflow you want to break into parallel AI agents; typically for repetitive tasks taking 5+ hours per week.

say_en.text: Design parallel AI agents for my weekly 6-hour competitive intel task.
say_en.note: It will ask about your current process first.

say_en.text: Convert our sequential AI workflow into a parallel agent system.
say_en.note: It identifies parallelizable steps and designs the flow.

say_en.text: Split customer feedback summarization into specialist agents with handoffs.
say_en.note: It outputs boundaries and human review points.
